title: Performance report (.gamestudio/reports/*.perf.json, evidence perf.json)
description: Measured performance of one build on one device for one scenario, compared with budgets (normally copied from contract technical.perf_budgets). perf_budget.py checks it against the contract; the perf gate accepts it as evidence. A "pass" verdict requires an empty violations list.

allOf.description: A passing perf report cannot list violations.

feature_id.description: Feature under test, when the report is gate evidence.

build.description: Build identifier (version, commit, configuration: release builds only for perf evidence).

name.description: Device model, e.g. "Galaxy A15" or "iPhone 12"; "editor" or "desktop-headless" for proxies (not valid perf evidence for release).

tier.description: Device tier as defined by the project's device matrix.

scenario.description: Reference scenario, e.g. "level 30 wave 10, max golems, VFX on"; budgets apply per scenario.

duration_sec.description: Length of the measured window in seconds (60+ s recommended so thermal effects show).

p1_low.description: 1% low FPS (FPS equivalent of the 99th-percentile frame time); exposes hitches the average hides.

p95.description: 95th-percentile frame time, ms; compared with frame_ms_p95 budget.

peak.description: Peak resident memory, MB; compared with memory_mb budget.

draw_calls.description: Average draw calls per frame (or peak; say which in notes).

cpu_ms.description: Average CPU (main + render thread critical path) time per frame, ms.

gpu_ms.description: Average GPU time per frame, ms, when the profiler exposes it.

thermal.description: Thermal state at the start and end of the window: iOS-style labels (nominal, fair, serious, critical), an Android thermal status number, or degrees Celsius.

end.description: Thermal state at end; a rise to serious/critical means throttling risk in long sessions.

download_mb.description: Install download size of the build in MB.

budgets.description: Budgets this report was judged against, normally contract technical.perf_budgets for the device tier (fps_target, frame_ms_p95, memory_mb, download_mb, cold_start_sec, optional draw_calls).

violations.description: Human-readable budget violations, e.g. "memory_mb.peak 512 > 450". Must be empty for a pass.

verdict.description: pass only when every measured metric is within budget.
